beats.label: S1 · Arrivals in Maui
beats.text: Guests arrive at the White Lotus Maui; honeymooner Shane fixates on a booking error and starts an escalating war with hotel manager Armond.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the resort, the manager, and the customer-complaint feud that will end in Armond's death.

beats.label: S1 · Tanya dangles a business
beats.text: Grieving heiress Tanya asks spa manager Belinda for a massage, then dangles a wellness-business partnership Belinda begins to plan her life around.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Tanya–Belinda dynamic that defines Tanya's cruelty and gives Belinda a stake worth losing.

beats.label: S1 · Armond relapses
beats.text: Armond, five years sober, relapses on drugs left behind by teen guest Paula and starts using with staff, unravelling as Shane keeps demanding his boss.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The relapse is the mechanism the Shane feud can now push toward catastrophe.

beats.label: S1 · Quinn drifts to the beach
beats.text: Mark's crumbling marriage plays out at dinners; young Quinn escapes each night to the beach, bonds with local canoeists, and starts imagining another life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Quinn's decision to walk off the plane home, the family's only real ending.

beats.label: S1 · The safe robbery
beats.text: Paula gives local worker Kai the Mossbachers' safe code; the robbery fails, Kai is arrested, and Rachel privately decides she married the wrong man.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Paula/Kai thread and hardens Rachel's crisis before her final reversal.

beats.label: S1 · Tanya picks Greg
beats.text: Tanya pursues fellow guest Greg instead, cancels on Belinda, and hands her cash rather than the business she'd promised.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single most load-bearing beat for the next season: this is where Tanya and Greg become a couple.

beats.label: S1 · Departures
beats.text: Fired for the sex scandal, drunk Armond defecates in Shane's suitcase and dies on Shane's pineapple knife; at the airport Rachel tells Shane she is happy after all.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the body in the cargo hold and the Shane–Rachel arc, closing the Maui week.

cliffhanger.text: Armond is in the cargo hold and Shane doesn't yet know he killed him. Rachel has chosen the marriage. Tanya has abandoned Belinda and boarded a new life with Greg.
questions: Will Tanya's whirlwind with Greg outlast the plane ride home?
Can Rachel actually live with the choice she just walked back to?
Will Belinda ever build the wellness life Tanya briefly promised?

characters.name: Tanya McQuoid
characters.line: Grieving heiress who came to scatter her mother's ashes; leaves the resort paired with fellow guest Greg after ditching Belinda.

characters.name: Greg
characters.line: Sport fisherman Tanya met poolside; her sudden new partner heading off the island with her.

characters.name: Shane Patton
characters.line: Entitled honeymooner who fatally stabbed the hotel manager mid-prank; boarding the flight home not knowing he's a killer.

characters.name: Rachel Patton
characters.line: Newlywed journalist who spent the trip realising she was a trophy wife and then talked herself back into the marriage.

characters.name: Belinda Lindsey
characters.line: Spa manager left with a cash tip and no partner; the wellness business she had started imagining is quietly dead.

characters.name: Quinn Mossbacher
characters.line: Youngest Mossbacher; walked out of the airport to stay in Hawaii and paddle with the local canoeists.

beats.label: S2 · Marriage on the rocks
beats.text: Tanya arrives in Sicily with distant husband Greg and her assistant Portia; furious to see Portia, Greg orders Tanya to keep her out of sight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Greg–Tanya rupture that everything in the season is quietly a consequence of.

beats.label: S2 · Two couples, one villa
beats.text: Ethan and Harper vacation with his abrasive college friend Cameron and glossy wife Daphne; Harper immediately reads them as fake and Cameron as trouble.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anchors the parallel arc about desire and infidelity that runs alongside the Tanya plot.

beats.label: S2 · Lucia and the Di Grassos
beats.text: Middle-aged Dominic hires local escort Lucia; his earnest son Albie meets her separately and falls for her while grandfather Bert quietly leers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the three-generation Di Grasso thread and the con Albie is being softly walked into.

beats.label: S2 · Greg leaves, Quentin arrives
beats.text: Greg abruptly flies home for 'work'; a tarot reader tells Tanya he loves someone else, and wealthy English expat Quentin folds her into his Palermo circle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the pivot: Greg out of frame is Greg setting the trap; Quentin arriving is the trap.

beats.label: S2 · Cameron and Lucia
beats.text: Cameron secretly sleeps with Lucia on a boys' night; Ethan hides it until Harper forces the truth, and he attacks Cameron, reigniting both marriages.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Spiller–Sullivan arc's whole payoff in one beat, kept compact because it resolves inside the season.

beats.label: S2 · The photograph
beats.text: Tanya spots a photo of a young Quentin with a young Greg and realises the entire group was hired by her husband to kill her for the fortune.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The recognition moment that turns the whole season retroactively into a murder plot.

beats.label: S2 · Yacht and beach
beats.text: Tanya shoots her way off Quentin's yacht but drowns escaping; on land, Lucia scams Albie's father out of €50,000 with a fake pimp and vanishes clean.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers the body, the inheritance flowing to Greg, and the season's other big con in one closer.

cliffhanger.text: Tanya is dead in the Ionian Sea, Greg has quietly inherited her fortune, and no one on the outside knows he arranged the hit.
questions: Will anyone ever tie Greg to Tanya's death?
What does Greg do with a fortune this large and this untouched?
Do the fragments Portia holds ever add up to evidence?

characters.name: Tanya McQuoid
characters.line: Dead; drowned trying to escape the yacht after killing the crew her husband hired to kill her.

characters.name: Greg Hunt
characters.line: Tanya's widower and sole heir; the whole plot ran through him and no one has connected it back.

characters.name: Portia
characters.line: Tanya's assistant, alive and rattled; senses something was very wrong at Quentin's but can't articulate what.

characters.name: Harper Spiller
characters.line: Ethan's wife; the marriage survived Cameron and came back into passion after weeks of suspicion.

characters.name: Ethan Spiller
characters.line: Wealthy tech founder; reconciled with Harper after nearly drowning Cameron in the surf.

characters.name: Albie Di Grasso
characters.line: Earnest Stanford grad; wired Lucia €50,000 of his father's money believing he was saving her.

beats.label: S3 · Rick hunts Jim
beats.text: Guests arrive at White Lotus Ko Samui; Rick brings young girlfriend Chelsea and immediately starts probing owner Jim Hollinger, who he believes killed his father.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the revenge that will drive the season's climax and eventually kill three people.

beats.label: S3 · Timothy's ruin arrives
beats.text: Wealthy Ratliff patriarch Timothy learns his business partner has flipped in a money-laundering case; prison is coming and every asset will be frozen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the financial collapse the entire Ratliff arc reacts to.

beats.label: S3 · Belinda spots Greg
beats.text: Belinda, visiting from White Lotus Maui, spots Tanya's widower Greg at the resort using a fake name — the man she now suspects had Tanya killed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reconnects the anthology across three seasons and lights the fuse on the Greg–Belinda leverage arc.

beats.label: S3 · The stolen gun
beats.text: Timothy steals guard Gaitok's gun and repeatedly rehearses killing himself and his family to spare them the coming humiliation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The gun and the fantasy set up both Gaitok's arc and the near-poisoning at the end.

beats.label: S3 · The yacht night
beats.text: On a molly night on Greg's yacht, girlfriend Chloe pulls Ratliff sons Saxon and Lochlan into an incestuous threesome none of them will speak of.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The event that reshapes both brothers privately and gives Greg's world its hold on the family.

beats.label: S3 · The hotel shootout
beats.text: Jim confronts Rick at the hotel and insults his mother; Rick shoots Jim dead, then learns Jim was his father. Chelsea dies in the shootout and Gaitok obediently kills Rick.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers the season's body count and, crucially, Gaitok's decisive kill that reshapes him.

beats.label: S3 · Five million to leave
beats.text: Belinda takes $5M in hush money from Greg and leaves for a new life with her son; Timothy tells his family everything is about to change.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The two live threads walking off the island — Belinda's payday and the Ratliffs' impending collapse.

cliffhanger.text: Belinda leaves Thailand rich on Greg's terms. Timothy has finally told his family the truth. Rick, Chelsea and Jim are dead in the villa that started it all.
questions: Does Belinda finally build the wellness life Tanya once dangled?
How long can Greg keep buying his way out of Tanya's death?
What happens to the Ratliffs when Timothy's crimes catch up in earnest?

characters.name: Belinda Lindsey
characters.line: Maui spa manager who took $5M from Greg and is finally leaving to build her own life with her son Zion.

characters.name: Greg Hunt
characters.line: Tanya's widower, exposed to Belinda but quickly paid off; still evading investigators, still hiding in plain sight.

characters.name: Timothy Ratliff
characters.line: Patriarch facing imminent arrest and total financial ruin; has just told his family everything on the last night.

characters.name: Victoria Ratliff
characters.line: Matriarch who spent the trip cushioned by lorazepam; now walking into a life she has no idea how to live.

characters.name: Gaitok
characters.line: Pacifist security guard who shot Rick on Sritala's order; promoted to her personal bodyguard as a reward.

characters.name: Lochlan Ratliff
characters.line: Youngest Ratliff; survived Timothy's aborted poisoning by accidentally drinking the leftovers, revived in his father's arms.
